location_exception_reason: Greenhouses are prefabricated structures with standardised technical specifications (GI frame, UV-stabilised polyethylene, IS 15827:2009 compliance) that function identically regardless of geographic origin. Buyer decision factors are structure type, glazing material, ventilation system, and subsidy eligibility — not location. Regional supplier concentration (Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat, Rajasthan) is a seller attribute, not a product attribute.
biz_exception_reason: IndiaMART's seller-type filter (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor, Exporter) already exposes business relationship independently. Removing 'Manufacturer', 'Supplier', or 'Dealer' from a greenhouse title leaves the product meaning complete and unchanged — the structure specifications and capabilities remain identical. Business type is redundant in the title.
